QC Ware has announced the 2026 Q2B Copenhagen Conference, scheduled for Q2 2026, which will concentrate on developing a roadmap to quantum value throughout Europe and beyond. The event is positioned as a key gathering for stakeholders in the quantum ecosystem to discuss strategic paths and commercialization opportunities. This announcement was released via PR Newswire and summarized by Google News aggregation services.
